name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility eases to MOVE 94; 10-year yield 4.89%, about 38bp lower on the month
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was about 94 on 4 Nov, down from about 100 on 3 Nov, and the US 10-year yield was 4.89%, about 38bp lower than a month earlier (Yahoo Finance). Both readings sit just under the Watch lines (MOVE 100, 40bp a month), so Watch is kept until they clear them. October payrolls on 6 Nov are the next test.
for_you: Bond markets remain more volatile than usual. Mortgage and loan pricing can move quickly while yields swing around data releases and central-bank decisions.
rubric_hit: MOVE 93.9 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds; US10y 1m move 38.3bp has not yet cleared the 36bp exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
